g.text: Synthetic fixture diagnostic; median and full observed range of measured batches
cleanroom: 3 batches × 10,000 calls after 5,000 warmups per mode; forge: 3 batches × 10,000 calls after 5,000 warmups per mode
ThreadMXBean counter deltas, not JFR samples or retained heap. Same writer; legacy buffer policy recreated in a MethodHandle wrapper.
Results escape; order alternates. Output byte equality checked by the diagnostic. No native-world throughput or overall speedup claim.
